title: Beyond Human Norms: Unveiling Unique Values of Large Language Models through Interdisciplinary Approaches

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing an LLM-specific value taxonomy (ValueLex) through generative value elicitation, factor analysis, and semantic clustering, followed by assessing the models' value inclinations (such as Competence, Character, and Integrity) using an adapted Sentence Completion Test (a projective psychological test).
